hero.title:
On Your Mat,

In Your Rhythm.
hero.description:
Discover Pilates from the comfort of your home — no gym required.

With a blend of traditional principles and modern movement, strengthen your body while calming your mind. At Pilates By DF, we guide you through home workouts so you can experience both physical grace and mental clarity together.

We're with you online through one-on-one (1:1) and group classes.We're here to make working out at home more enjoyable, safer, and more accessible.

items.question: Can I cancel my membership anytime?
items.answer: Yes, you can cancel your membership at any time. Cancellation takes effect from the next billing cycle.

items.question: How do I join live classes?
items.answer: Premium and VIP members can access the live class calendar and make reservations through the app or web dashboard.

items.question: How are 1:1 sessions scheduled?
items.answer: VIP members schedule weekly sessions, and Premium members schedule monthly 1:1 sessions directly with their instructors.
